# koyeb_database (Data Source)

Database data source in the Koyeb Terraform provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "koyeb_database" "my-database" {
  name = "my-database"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The database name; the app and the service both carry this name

### Read-Only

- `app_id` (String) The app ID the database service is assigned to
- `created_at` (String) The date and time of when the database was created
- `id` (String) The database service ID
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID owning the database
- `status` (String) The status of the database service
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time of when the database was last updated
- `version` (String) The version of the database service
